# CONFORMANCE FIXTURES: the free-function vocabulary (spec 6.2/6.3) and the numeric
# methods. Trigonometry is degrees in, degrees out.

== clamp inside
expr Clamp(5, 0, 10)
want num 5

== clamp below
expr Clamp(-1, 0, 10)
want num 0

== clamp above
expr Clamp(15, 0, 10)
want num 10

== clamp as a method
expr (15).Clamp(0, 10)
want num 10

== mapRange
expr MapRange(5, 0, 10, 0, 100)
want num 50

== mapRange extrapolates
expr MapRange(15, 0, 10, 0, 100)
want num 150

== mapRange as a method takes the four bounds
expr (5).MapRange(0, 10, 0, 100)
want num 50

== a collapsed mapRange is unknown
expr MapRange(5, 3, 3, 0, 100)
want nil

== roundTo
expr RoundTo(3.14159, 2)
want num 3.14

== lerp
expr Lerp(0, 10, 0.5)
want num 5

== abs
expr Abs(-3)
want num 3

== round half away from zero
expr Round(2.5)
want num 3

== floor
expr Floor(2.9)
want num 2

== ceil
expr Ceil(2.1)
want num 3

== floor as a method
expr (2.9).Floor()
want num 2

== ceil as a method
expr (2.1).Ceil()
want num 3

== abs as a method
expr (-3).Abs()
want num 3

== round as a method takes a decimal count
expr (3.14159).Round(2)
want num 3.14

== sign of a negative
expr (-7).Sign()
want num -1

== sqrt
expr Sqrt(9)
want num 3

== sqrt of a negative is unknown
expr Sqrt(-1)
want nil

== pow
expr Pow(2, 10)
want num 1024

== min
expr Min(3, 7)
want num 3

== max
expr Max(3, 7)
want num 7

== sin in degrees
expr Sin(90)
want num 1

== cos in degrees
expr Cos(0)
want num 1

== tan in degrees
expr Tan(45)
want num 1

== asin answers degrees
expr Asin(1)
want num 90

== asin outside its domain is unknown
expr Asin(2)
want nil

== acos answers degrees
expr Acos(1)
want num 0

== atan2 answers degrees
expr Atan2(1, 0)
want num 90

== fmtDuration seconds
expr FmtDuration(42)
want text "42s"

== fmtDuration minutes
expr FmtDuration(90)
want text "1m 30s"

== fmtDuration hours
expr FmtDuration(3700)
want text "1h 1m"

== fmtDuration negative
expr FmtDuration(-5)
want text "-5s"

== not is a method on bool
env on: bool = false
expr on.Not()
want bool true

== pick chooses by the receiver
env on: bool = true
expr on.Pick(10, 20)
want num 10

== pick the other way
env on: bool = false
expr on.Pick(10, 20)
want num 20

== pick carries any shape
env on: bool = true
expr on.Pick("a", "b")
want text "a"

== bool int
env on: bool = true
expr on.Int()
want num 1

== toFixed refuses on the wire but int does not
tier wire
env on: bool = true
expr Int(on)
want num 1

== fmtDuration is display vocabulary
tier wire
expr FmtDuration(90)
error display vocabulary

== jet is display vocabulary
tier wire
expr Jet(0.5)
error display vocabulary

== clamp01 is not a scalar builtin
expr Clamp01(0.5)
error unknown function

== measure is not a scalar builtin
expr Measure("x", 16)
error unknown function

== anchor is not a scalar builtin
expr Anchor(0.5, 0.5)
error unknown function

== an unknown function refuses by name
expr frobnicate(1)
error unknown function 'frobnicate'

== the arity refusal names the whole legal range
expr Rgb(1, 0, 0, 1, 1)
error Rgb takes 3 or 4 arguments

== clamp arity
expr Clamp(1, 2)
error Clamp takes 3 arguments
